decision_rationale: Despite a positive feature funnel completion rate, the overwhelming consensus and data strongly indicate critical stability and usability issues that necessitate a pause. The crash rate remains unacceptably high at 0.95 (171.4% above baseline), support tickets have spiked to 155 (307.9% above baseline), and 7-day retention has fallen below the threshold at 39.2%.  User feedback consistently highlights data loss (KI-001), latency (KI-002), and the lack of a disable toggle (KI-004), contributing to a negative sentiment timeline, particularly on days 4-6. The 'fix-in-progress' for the context boundary issue (KI-003) presents a significant potential privacy/security risk.  The drop in payment success rate to 97.8 is also a concerning indicator. These issues collectively outweigh the positive funnel completion data and pose a significant risk to user trust and business sustainability.
confidence_drivers: KI-001 (draft content loss) fix confirmed and verified through user testing → +0.15
Context boundary issue (KI-003) fully resolved and audited → +0.20
Significant reduction in crash rate (below 0.5) and support ticket volume (below 100) after addressing root causes → +0.25
User sentiment score trending positive after release of disable toggle → +0.10
Further increase in crash rate or retention decline → -0.20
Re-emergence of context boundary issue or discovery of new privacy/security vulnerabilities → -0.30

final_verdicts.rationale: While the feature funnel completion rate is positive, the overwhelming consensus from the Data Analyst, Marketing & Comms, and Risk/Critic teams, coupled with the severity of the observed issues, necessitates a continued pause. The crash rate remains unacceptably high (171.4% above baseline), support ticket volume is extraordinarily elevated (307.9% above baseline), and 7-day retention remains below the threshold. The Risk/Critic's concerns regarding the 'fix-in-progress' for the context boundary issue (KI-003) and the potential for privacy or security implications are particularly concerning and warrant a thorough investigation before any further rollout. The Marketing & Comms team's feedback on user sentiment and the lack of a disable toggle further reinforces the need for a pause to address usability concerns and restore user trust. The Data Analyst's identification of a drop in payment success rate is also a critical red flag that needs immediate attention.

Payment success rate dropped to 97.8, a notable decrease.
recommended_actions: Immediately investigate and resolve the root cause of the increased crash rate, prioritizing server log and client-side diagnostic analysis.
Analyze support tickets to identify common themes and prioritize fixes. Categorize and track recurring issues.
Expedite the release of a user-facing toggle to disable Smart Compose (as planned for v4.12.1).
Thoroughly re-evaluate the model's context window logic to address the context boundary issue (KI-003) and implement robust safeguards.
Investigate the drop in payment success rate and identify any correlation with the Smart Compose rollout.
Implement more granular monitoring and alerting for key metrics, especially around latency and error rates.
Consider A/B testing the feature with a smaller, more controlled group after addressing the critical issues.
